summary_1line: Karna endures a worm’s torment while Parashurama sleeps, revealing his non‑Brahmin identity and earning a curse before later aiding Duryodhana in abducting a princess.

image_candidates.scene_text: Parashurama sleeps with his head on Karna’s lap while a monstrous eight‑legged worm burrows into Karna’s bleeding thigh as he silently endures the pain.
The slain worm transforms into a dark Rakshasa rising in the sky above the forest, hands folded in gratitude before Parashurama.
Duryodhana seizes the princess onto his chariot at the svayamvara while Karna stands behind him in armor as enraged kings raise their weapons.
